interval_s.description: Seconds between detector runs while scanning

min_score.description: Detections below this score are left out

sample_spread.description: Depth is sampled at the box's centre and at four points this fraction of the box's width and height from it

max_range_m.description: Depth hits farther than this are left out

floor_y_m.description: The floor's height in quest_tracking (the Quest's floor-level origin puts it at 0)

floor_margin_m.description: A point more than this below the floor is impossible and left out

min_reach_m.description: The smallest distance within which a sighting joins an object of its category

reach_factor.description: The reach grows to this fraction of the object's measured size

min_frames.description: Frames an object must be seen in before it is in the scene

viewpoint_m.description: Camera positions closer than this count as one viewpoint

max_points_per_object.description: The most recent depth points an object keeps for its median

publish_interval_s.description: At most this often, a changed scene is published to the session

save_images_max.description: At most this many frames are saved as images each session; the previous session's images are deleted when a scan starts

space_setup.description: When the app asks the headset for Space Setup, Meta's room scan: every time the scan starts, only when the headset has no room, or never (depth only)

box_margin_m.description: A detection's depth point this close to one of Meta's boxes counts as inside it

room_margin_m.description: A depth point farther than this outside the room's floor outline, or below its floor or above its ceiling, is outside the room

min_box_votes.description: Sightings of its leading category a box Meta calls OTHER needs before the detector names it

box_categories.description: Standard categories whose sightings inside a box vote for it (furniture); every other category is placed by depth, even on a box

sample_grid.description: Depth is sampled on a sample_grid by sample_grid grid of points in each detection's box, at the centres of equal cells

depth_window_m.description: A detection's depth points farther than this from its median distance are the background, not its surface

point_voxel_m.description: An object keeps one surface point per voxel of this size

box_points_max.description: Past this many points, an object's voxel doubles and its points are thinned again

box_trim.description: Each side of a fitted box drops this fraction of points at either end, so stray rays don't stretch it

top_allowance_m.description: Furniture seen up to this far above a box's top counts as resting on it, so as that box

box_completion.description: Grow each box's hidden side to its category's size prior, away from where it was seen

floor_categories.description: Categories whose boxes reach down to the floor

box_max_over_prior.description: A box side longer than this many times its category's measured size shrinks to that size, centred on the object's points (a small thing's samples landing on the surface around it)

id.description: Lower-case identifier: letters, digits, '_', '.', '-'; starts with a letter or digit.
